description.value:
The cold light of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-netherworld.items.Item.nwShroudOfName01]{Shroud of the Nameless} wards this creature against the Queen of Shadows' rime. The Glass's emanation passes over them — the aura will not apply @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-netherworld.effects.Item.nwQueensRimeFx01]{Effect: The Queen's Rime} to a warded creature, so they take no rime damage, make no save, suffer no clumsy or Speed penalty, and ignore the rimed difficult terrain. (This wards against the rime only — the creature can still be harmed by other cold during the fight.)

Apply to the Shroud's bearer and their whole party at the start of the Dark Mirror (Encounter 3); remove it when the fight ends.
